skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — cut the best moments, add music and transitions, and export as a short vid...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Maker Editor Free — fast, free AI-powered video editing and creation.

- Instantly create and edit videos by describing your desired results; no pro editing experience required.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Automatic AI-powered video cutting, music, transitions, and export to 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- No software install or paid account needed — 100 free credits for new users.
- Handles common workflows like fast edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Clear feedback and robust error handling for uploads, credits, export, and session setup.
